title: Archive and Protocol
author: Jonah Voss
blurb: Astrid Thackeray, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
